newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian base metals steady in sluggish trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian base metals steady in sluggish trade.

text.p: Indian base metal prices were steady on Friday on poor industrial demand and limited supplies, dealers said.
Bombay Metal Exchange president Sharad Parikh said supplies of imported metals from the port to the market had not picked up after truckers called off a 11-day stir on Thursday.
"About 1,000-1,500 tonnes of imported metal are lying at the port," he said.

In the ready delivery copper was steady at 13,500 rupees per quintal, zinc at 7,850 rupees and lead at 4,550 rupees. Aluminium was unchanged at 7,450 rupees, tin at 31,600 rupees and nickel at 36,800 rupees.
